sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: This Advance Market Notice is provided to inform prospective tenderers of the proposed services and support market awareness ahead of the anticipated release of the RFT.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
NSW Ambulance is intending to request proposals for the provision of Paramedics Income Protection Insurance required as part of the “NSW AMBULANCE DEATH AND INCOME PROTECTION BENEFITS (STATE) REVIEWED AWARD 2022”.

The purpose of the tender is to:

- Ensure an income protection insurance policy that meets the needs of Paramedics cover under the above Award,
- Achieve sustainable and competitive premiums,
- Secure a rate guarantee period of at least 24 months,
- Appoint an insurance partner that delivers proactive and supportive claims management, high-quality insights and meaningful reporting to support informed decision-making and the strategic objectives of People and Culture team at NSW Ambulance.

The information contained in this notice is indicative only and is subject to change.The publication of this notice does not constitute a commitment by HealthShare NSW or NSW Ambulance to proceed with any procurement process.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content: Further details regarding the scope of service, evaluation methodology and procurement timeline will be provided in the forthcoming Request for Tender (RFT) documentation anticipated to be released in September 2026.
